description: Representative clinical PK at label dose, one or more drugs per class. uM values use free-base MW computed from the molecular formula. Total (bound + unbound) plasma concentrations unless stated; multiply by fraction_unbound for free drug.

drugs.mw_note: label MW 615.7 is the mesylate salt; plasma concentrations refer to free base

terminal_half_life_h.note: oral, absorption-limited; IV microdose t1/2 2.6 h; hydroxy-dabrafenib 10 h; carboxy/desmethyl 21-22 h
terminal_half_life_h.source: FDA label (openFDA, raw/fda_labels/TAFINLAR.json), section 12.3; EMA SmPC (raw/ema/tafinlar.pdf), section 5.2

time_to_steady_state.value: ~14 days (auto-induction: CL/F rises from 17 L/h single dose to 34 L/h after 2 weeks bid; accumulation ratio 0.7)

drugs.notes: Active metabolites hydroxy- and desmethyl-dabrafenib contribute (metabolite/parent AUC ratios 0.9, 11 (carboxy), 0.7).

label_dose.value: 450 mg once daily (melanoma, with binimetinib 45 mg bid); 300 mg once daily (BRAF V600E CRC, with cetuximab)

terminal_half_life_h.source: FDA label (openFDA, raw/fda_labels/BRAFTOVI.json), section 12.3; EMA SmPC (raw/ema/braftovi.pdf), section 5.2

Cmax_ss.note: not stated in FDA label or EMA SmPC; not collected

time_to_steady_state.value: within 15 days; steady-state exposure 50% lower than day 1 (CYP3A4 auto-induction)

drugs.mw_note: label molecular mass 693.5 is the DMSO solvate

terminal_half_life_h.note: SmPC mean terminal t1/2 after single dose 127 h (5.3 days); FDA label: estimated elimination t1/2 3.9-4.8 days; Infante 2012 effective t1/2 ~4 days
terminal_half_life_h.source: EMA SmPC (raw/ema/mekinist.pdf), section 5.2; FDA label (openFDA, raw/fda_labels/MEKINIST.json), section 12.3

Cmax_ss.source: EMA SmPC (raw/ema/mekinist.pdf), section 5.2 (same values in Infante et al., Lancet Oncol 2012, PMID 22805291)

drugs.brand: Tarceva (generic label used for FDA text)
drugs.mw_note: label MW 429.9 is the HCl salt

label_dose.value: 150 mg orally once daily (NSCLC), on an empty stomach; 100 mg qd with gemcitabine (pancreatic)

terminal_half_life_h.note: median, population PK (n=591); Hidalgo 2001 phase I: 24.4 ± 14.6 h
terminal_half_life_h.source: FDA label (openFDA, raw/fda_labels/ERLOTINIB.json), section 12.3; Lu et al., Clin Pharmacol Ther 2006, PMID 16890575

Cmax_ss.note: steady-state Cmax not stated in label/SmPC abstracts; single-dose 150 mg Cmax 1056 ng/mL in non-smoking healthy volunteers (EMA SmPC 5.2)

Ctrough_ss.source: Hidalgo et al., J Clin Oncol 2001, PMID 11432895 (abstract)
Ctrough_ss.smoking: steady-state trough 1.28 µg/mL in former/never smokers vs 0.65 µg/mL in current smokers (EMA SmPC 5.2)

Cavg_ss.source: derived: dose/(CL/F x 24 h), CL/F 4.47 L/h (EMA SmPC 5.2)

label_dose.value: 400 mg/m2 IV loading dose then 250 mg/m2 weekly, or 500 mg/m2 every 2 weeks

Cmax_ss.stat: mean peak across studies, 400/250 mg/m2 weekly

drugs.notes: Nonlinear (target-mediated) clearance: CL fell from 0.08 to 0.02 L/h/m2 as dose rose from 20 to 200 mg/m2, plateau above 200 mg/m2.

label_dose.value: 300 mg orally once daily with food

Ctrough_ss.note: not stated in label; one-compartment estimate with t1/2 8.5 h and Tmax ~3 h gives ~0.25 x Cmax ≈ 600 ng/mL (rough derivation, not a measured value)

label_dose.value: 400 mg orally once daily with a meal after a 5-week ramp-up (20/50/100/200/400 mg), CLL/SLL; AML dosing differs (label 2.3)

Cmax_ss.stat: mean ± SD 2.1 ± 1.1 µg/mL, 400 mg qd, low-fat meal

time_to_steady_state.value: unverified; ~5 days expected from 26 h half-life (5 half-lives), label says PK does not change over time

drugs.notes: Selective BCL-2; solid-tumour relevance limited. Food raises exposure 3.4-5.3x.

label_dose.value: no label. Phase I/II solid tumour + trametinib RP2D: navitoclax 250 mg daily d1-28 with trametinib 2 mg d1-14 (Corcoran et al., Clin Cancer Res 2024, PMID 38456660); solid-tumour monotherapy phase I used a 1-week 150 mg lead-in then continuous daily dosing (Gandhi et al., J Clin Oncol 2011, PMID 21282543, abstract); the 325 mg daily phase II dose is unverified

terminal_half_life_h.source: Wilson et al., Lancet Oncol 2010, PMID 21094089, Table 3 (all doses, day -3)

Cmax_ss.stat: mean, day 14, 315 mg daily, n=8 (lymphoid malignancies)
Cmax_ss.source: Wilson et al., Lancet Oncol 2010, PMID 21094089, Table 3 (PMC3025495)

Cavg_day1_315mg.source: derived: AUC0-24 day 1 / 24 h (underestimates steady state; day-14 Cmax was ~1.5x day 1)

time_to_steady_state.value: unverified; ~3-4 days expected from 17 h half-life
